content.value_statement: Software teams need current guidance that fits their codebase and constraints. This skill researches options, compares trade-offs, and turns best practices into practical recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Researches best practices for architecture, APIs, security, performance, testing, and code quality.
Compares multiple implementation approaches with trade-offs and context fit.
Reviews local project patterns before recommending changes.
Uses WebSearch and WebFetch when current documentation is needed.
Provides structured recommendations with alternatives, pitfalls, and implementation guidance.
limitations: Guidance depends on source quality and may require current web research.
It does not run benchmarks or prove performance claims by itself.
It cannot replace a formal security review for high-risk systems.
Some optional helper scripts named in the skill are not included in the scanned package.

use_cases.title: Choose an implementation pattern
use_cases.description: Compare options for authentication, state management, error handling, or similar engineering choices before implementation.

use_cases.title: Standardize team guidance
use_cases.description: Create consistent recommendations for architecture, code quality, testing, and performance across a project.

use_cases.title: Review API design
use_cases.description: Check REST or GraphQL designs against naming, versioning, pagination, security, documentation, and monitoring practices.

prompt_templates.title: Find best practices
prompt_templates.prompt: Find best practices for [topic]. Include current standards, common trade-offs, and a clear recommendation for a small project.

prompt_templates.title: Review my approach
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my current approach to [feature]. Compare it against project patterns and current guidance. Identify risks, gaps, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Compare options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [option A], [option B], and [option C] for [context]. Score them by maintainability, security, performance, cost, and team fit.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a decision record
prompt_templates.prompt: Research a decision record for [architecture choice]. Use official docs first, cite sources, include constraints, rejected alternatives, migration path, and review checklist.

output_examples.input: What is the best way to handle authentication in a React app?
output_examples.output: A recommendation comparing cookie sessions, OAuth/OIDC, and token approaches, with security trade-offs and migration steps.

output_examples.input: Is our error handling approach following best practices?
output_examples.output: An assessment of strengths, missing logging, recovery gaps, user message quality, and prioritized improvements.

output_examples.input: Compare REST and GraphQL for our analytics product.
output_examples.output: A decision summary covering consumer needs, query complexity, caching, tooling, operational risk, and the recommended default.

best_practices: Provide project context, constraints, and existing patterns before asking for recommendations.
Ask for trade-offs and alternatives, not only a single answer.
Request source citations when guidance depends on current frameworks, standards, or security rules.
anti_patterns: Do not apply a pattern only because it is popular.
Do not ignore team skills, maintenance cost, or delivery constraints.
Do not treat generated recommendations as approval for high-risk security changes.

faq.question: Does this skill browse the web?
faq.answer: It can use WebSearch and WebFetch when current sources are needed, subject to host tool permissions.

faq.question: Can it review existing code?
faq.answer: Yes. It can read local files and compare project patterns with documented best practices.

faq.question: Is it only for security work?
faq.answer: No. It covers security, performance, API design, testing, architecture, and code quality.

faq.question: Does it make final technical decisions?
faq.answer: No. It recommends approaches and explains trade-offs so project owners can decide.

faq.question: Does it include automation scripts?
faq.answer: The skill mentions helper scripts, but those scripts were not present in the scanned files.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The package declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
